methodology.quote: Latest saved Pinnacle observation at or before kickoff, paired with a Graham fair timestamp at or before kickoff.
methodology.selection: Choose home when the Graham home fair is lower than the Pinnacle home line; otherwise choose away. Identical lines choose the Pinnacle favourite; home on a pick’em.
methodology.returns: Illustrative only: 1u risk at -110 for every strategy, including pushes in the risk denominator. Saved home odds are audit data and are not used to invent missing away odds.
methodology.history: No issued report, fair, market snapshot, stake or settlement is rewritten.
